LanguageData.LotRM_G_ArmorOne.label: Ithilien Gear
LanguageData.LotRM_G_ArmorOne.description:
The rangers of the south are unparalleled in their stealth.
Unlock Ithilien ranger outfit: - Ithilien ranger hood - Ithilien ranger gear
LanguageData.LotRM_G_ArmorThree.label: Nobility of Gondor
LanguageData.LotRM_G_ArmorThree.description:
Since the absence of the kingship, the stewards have watched over Gondor, awaiting the return of the king.
Unlock Gondorian noble items: - Gondorian crown - Fountain-guard Helmet
LanguageData.LotRM_G_ArmorTwo.label: Armor of Gondor
LanguageData.LotRM_G_ArmorTwo.description:
Gondor's blacksmiths are amongst the best of all mankind.
Unlock Gondorian armor: - Gondor plate helmet - Fountain-guard Helmet - Gondor full plate
LanguageData.LotRM_G_WeaponsOne.label: Spears and Bows of the White Tree
LanguageData.LotRM_G_WeaponsOne.description: Gondor! Gondor, between the Mountains and the Sea! West Wind blew there; light upon the Silver Tree Unlock the classic weapons of Gondor: - Gondor Spear - Ithilien Ranger Bow
LanguageData.LotRM_G_WeaponsThree.label: Swan-Blades of Dol Amroth
LanguageData.LotRM_G_WeaponsThree.description: "Amroth for Gondor!" they cried. "Amroth to Faramir!" Unlock the arsenal wielded by the swan-knights of Dol Amroth: - Knight blade - Swan Knight blade
LanguageData.LotRM_G_WeaponsTwo.label: Weapons of War
LanguageData.LotRM_G_WeaponsTwo.description: "The beacons of Gondor are alight, calling for aid. War is kindled." Unlock proper Gondorian weapons: - Gondorian Sword - Gondorian Shield
